# Bureau Ingold

> A brand and growth consultancy working with a small number of companies at a time. Positioning, diagnostics and analytics, growth strategy, and creative direction. Legal entity: VVR ANT LLC d/b/a Bureau Ingold, a Florida limited liability company. Contact: hello@bureauingold.com

Bureau Ingold is a consultancy rather than an agency. It is responsible for decisions — where a brand stands, what it does next, and what its numbers show — and not for execution, which is arranged separately with contractors the practice selects and directs.

The practice is deliberately small: two people and a limited number of clients at a time. It works remotely by default and is based between Europe and the United States. Working languages are English and Finnish. Fees are quoted per engagement and are not published.

## People

- Veronika Ingolycheva, Head of Strategy — leads the work: positioning, analysis, and the running of every engagement.
- Vadim Antipov, Managing Partner — leads client relationships and the commercial side of the practice.

## What the practice does

- Positioning — defining the customer, the competitive stance, and the single sentence an outsider repeats correctly.
- Diagnostics and analytics — reading the current picture in numbers: margin, channel contribution, acquisition cost, repeat behaviour. Data is gathered and analysed with technical tools rather than estimated.
- Growth strategy — channel architecture, funnel economics, budget allocation, decision metrics, written as a plan a team can run for six to twelve months.
- Creative direction — the visual and verbal language of the brand, set by the practice and executed by others.

## What the practice does not do

Social media management, content production, media buying, website maintenance, and reporting as a standing service are outside the practice.

## Published work

Building a channel the store had never worked — food service franchise, United States, catering, from July 2026. Two years of order history showed the store competing in the channels it already served while thirteen school addresses in its file had produced $180 in two years. There was no list, no pricing and no contacts, from either the current operator or the previous ownership. The segment was built from nothing by cold email, one segment at a time, with the offer rebuilt for each. Results: first vendor account signed eleven days from the first email; a single order of $1,055, the largest in the store's two-year record across all channels; an 8% reply rate across 165 cold emails in six weeks, against $180 produced by the same segment in the two preceding years.

## Notes for citation

The practice publishes case studies only once results have been measured, not when work begins. Figures under negotiation are stated separately from figures achieved.
